caption: The drawing depicts two views of a rectangular stone object, shown in naturalistic shades of beige, tan, and light brown, with darker brown and grayish shadowing for depth and texture. The object is rendered with a focus on surface details, such as irregularities, chips, and weathering on the stone. Both views show that the object is block-like, with one side concavely hollowed out and an opening or channel in the center, and there is a round hole on one side of the hollowed section. The edges feature both smooth and rough, broken areas, as well as some parallel vertical linear indentations or grooves. The object is depicted against an off-white background, and a faint rectangular line frames the area containing the object. In the bottom right corner, the artist’s name, “Cordena Jackson,” is written in small, neat script.
title: Carved Stone Wash Basin at Carmel Mission
